# ТехБлог - Russian Tech Blog

> A high-performance, SEO-optimized Russian tech blog covering AI, web development, and emerging technologies.

## Site Information
- Name: ТехБлог
- URL: https://example.com
- Language: Russian (ru-RU)
- Topics: Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Technology Trends, Programming
- Author: Админ

## Content Structure
- /blog/ - All blog posts (Markdown content with rich frontmatter)
- /tags/ - Posts organized by tags
- /rss.xml - Standard RSS 2.0 feed
- /turbo.xml - Yandex Turbo Pages feed
- /sitemap-index.xml - XML Sitemap

## Key Content Areas
- AI and Machine Learning tutorials and trends
- Web development best practices (Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind)
- Technology news and analysis
- Programming guides and tips
- Neural network and generative AI guides
- Prompt engineering tutorials

## Content Format
Each blog post includes:
- Title and description (Russian)
- Publication date
- Author attribution
- Featured image
- Tags for categorization
- Optional TL;DR summary for quick reading
- Optional entity links (Wikidata/Wikipedia) for semantic context

## Technical Implementation
- Framework: Astro 4.x (Static Site Generation)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 3.x
- Content: Markdown with YAML frontmatter
- Schema.org: WebSite, Organization, BreadcrumbList, BlogPosting, FAQPage

## Structured Data
This site implements rich structured data:
- WebSite schema with site name and URL
- Organization schema with social links
- BreadcrumbList for navigation context
- BlogPosting for articles with author, dates, and keywords
- FAQPage for frequently asked questions

## API Endpoints (Internal Use Only)
- /api/* - Internal API routes (not for crawling)
- /admin/* - Admin panel (authentication required)

## Crawling Guidelines
- All blog content at /blog/* is freely accessible
- No authentication required for public content
- Content updated multiple times per week
- Sitemap: /sitemap-index.xml
- RSS Feed: /rss.xml
- No crawl rate restrictions

## Contact
- Telegram: @techblog_channel
- Website contact form available
